none: PAS NLM-1A5695: Roman Coin: Nummus of Constantine I
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), Comiti AVGG issue, possibly of 310-319, Reece period 15. Trier mint. Obverse description: Bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS [?IMP]. Reverse description: Sol standing left holding globe, chlamys over arm, possibly star in lower right field. Reverse inscription: COMITI AV[GGG?]. In exergue: PTR. Diameter: 21.6mm,…
